A '''lupine species''' of bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] lived on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the border of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space.<ref name="KOTOR8" /> They had lupine lower legs, with high ankle joints and three-clawed feet. The species had pointed ears and gray skin, with red eyes. They had sharp teeth and typically wore hoods.<ref name="KOTOR22">[[Knights of the Old Republic 22|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 22]]</ref>

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], their homeworld was conquered by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces under control of [[Rohlan Dyre]], a commander of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] who was trying to escape the army so as to discover the true motivation of the Mandalorian expansion. He killed many of the species while making his escape.<ref name="KOTOR8" /> A couple of members were caught on the surveillance tapes of [[Eejee Vamm]] while the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] was searching for [[Gorman Vandrayk]].<ref name="KOTOR13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref> Later, at least one member of the species was part of the [[Taris Resistance]] after the planet was conquered by the Mandalorians. He was present when [[Shel Jelavan]] attacked [[Zayne Carrick]] on his arrival at the Resistance base.<ref name="KOTOR22" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species was created by [[Dustin Weaver]] and has appeared as a background species in three issues of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]].
